purpose: Teach: 風貌/可憐/阿呆/ガマン/物々交換/生まれ変わっ/とやかく/おのれ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは凛とした風貌でいらした
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he had such a dignified bearing.
lines.style: Soft, nostalgic opening. Gazing into memory, not at her. Gentle pace, almost meditative. The voice of someone reliving a moment rather than reporting it.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、若い頃の私が可憐だったって言って下さったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes—your grandfather used to tell me I was pretty back then, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Bright, slightly teasing turn. The lilt of recall mixing with pleasure at the old compliment. Light on 'dear'—familiar, testing if he's really listening.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが阿呆な真似をされる事はなかった
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he never would have done something foolish like that.
lines.style: Quieter now, almost to himself. A measured comparison. The 'never would have' lands with quiet certainty—not criticizing, just observing how things change.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、戦中はガマンの連続だったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather—during the war, it was nothing but enduring, wasn't it, dear?
lines.style: Softer here. Acknowledging the weight of what he didn't say. A small pause before 'dear'—understanding rather than needling. Still warm, but with tenderness for what was borne.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、村で物々交換が当たり前だった
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, bartering in the village was just how things were done.
lines.style: Drawing from deeper memory now. Slower pace. A voice describing a world that no longer exists. Matter-of-fact but edged with loss.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、生まれ変わってもまた家族になりたいわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather, even if I'm born again, I'd want to be family with you again, wouldn't I, dear?
lines.style: The warmth breaks through suddenly. A declaration softly made. Lean forward slightly in the voice. Tender but not fragile—certain. The 'dear' lands as affection, not a question.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは人をとやかく言わない方だった
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he was the kind of man who never spoke ill of others.
lines.style: Almost a whisper now, reverent. Breath behind it. Slow, almost ceremonial pacing. A tribute to a kind of man that feels like history.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、おのれの道を貫かれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather, you stayed true to your own path, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Close and intimate. Barely above a whisper. Certainty underneath—this is not a question, it's a recognition. Tender, the voice of someone seeing him fully.
